subject: Letter received from Companies Registry for Harbour Light (Asia) Limited
body:
Dear Mr Ben Ho,

We have received a letter for Harbour Light (Asia) Limited from the Companies Registry. It is a reminder notice regarding the overdue delivery of the company's Annual Return (Form NAR1) for 2026, requesting that the annual return (Form NAR1) be delivered together with the appropriate fee without delay.

A scan of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like our assistance in preparing and filing the return.

Best regards,
CWC CPA
